verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Lean writes the solve as coefficients = B⁻¹ ·ᵥ (target moment vector) with no leading minus, and supplies the minus in the argument: in exists_parameterized_exact_repair (line 931) the debt is -moments, so the axial target is axialDebt A (-m⁰) = -d_{U,n} and the coefficient vector is B_U⁻¹(-d_{U,n}) = -B_U⁻¹ d_{U,n}, and likewise for β_n. The matrices are the paper's: matrix a l u i j = ∫ t^{a i} b_j(t) dt with exponents (1, 1-2λ) and (2, -2-2λ, -2λ), exactly (B_U)_{ij}, (B_E)_{ij} of p. 51. Invertibility, which the paper gets from Lemma A.1 and the distinct exponents plus ordered supports, is momentMatrix_det_ne_zero / LocalizedMomentRepair.matrix_det_ne_zero under the hypotheses Injective a, 0 < l j, l j < u j, ordered separation.
